assumptions: One local user indexes UTF-8 Markdown files.

decisions.title: Local JSON search index
decisions.context: Search must work offline without a database service.
decisions.decision: Persist a generated JSON index beside the notes directory.
consequences: Index writes are atomic and notes remain read-only.

phases.name: Offline index
phases.objective: Index and search local Markdown notes.

tasks.title: Set up the package and build the Markdown index
tasks.objective: Create the npm test foundation, then scan Markdown and atomically persist a local index.
acceptanceCriteria: Package metadata defines an npm test script for the project.
exclusions: No search CLI in this task.

tasks.title: Add index and search commands
tasks.objective: Expose indexing and keyword search through the CLI.
exclusions: No web UI, sync, or watcher.

risks.description: An interrupted write could leave invalid JSON.
risks.mitigation: Write a temporary file and atomically rename it.
